headline: Spanish olive oil giant shares drop 23% following acquisition
summary: Shares of a major Spanish olive oil producer fell 23% following a 520 million euro acquisition deal. The move is expected to significantly reshape the global olive oil market.
why: Consolidation in the food commodity sector can lead to price volatility and changes in market share for global agricultural products.

impacts.name: Food and Beverage
impacts.why: Large M&A deals in the food sector can trigger competitive shifts and price adjustments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The sharp decline suggests investors are skeptical of the acquisition price or the strategic rationale behind the deal.
